covington.name: Covington
covington.desc: Relish's town. The factory. Every slab, vat and simulacrum in the realm answers to this yard.

vei.name: Vei's Domain
vei.desc: The goddess of life holds the high country. She believes she can never be the throttle. She is wrong about exactly one thing: the pace.

forts.name: Ashgate
forts.desc: A toll gate on the Covington road. Small garrison, thin walls, first to fall.

forts.name: Old Sluice
forts.desc: A drowned water-works. The living here spend more time bailing than fighting.

forts.name: Greywall
forts.desc: A single long rampart and not much behind it.

forts.name: Vespers
forts.desc: A fortified chapel that rings its bells at dusk. The bells are a muster call.

forts.name: Chime Fort
forts.desc: Wind chimes strung on every parapet — the garrison listens for silence.

forts.name: Lantern Keep
forts.desc: Keeps a beacon lit for Vei's convoys. Snuffing it would sting her logistics.

forts.name: Hollow Redoubt
forts.desc: Dug into a hillside honeycombed with old crypts. Rich ground for a necromancer.

forts.name: Pale Bastion
forts.desc: Whitewashed walls, zealous garrison. They burn their dead — when they get the chance.

forts.name: Mourner's Gate
forts.desc: The old funerary road passed through here. It remembers.

forts.name: The Stair
forts.desc: A switchback fortress climbing toward the domain. Vei's soldiers arrive here fresh.

forts.name: Whitecross
forts.desc: Her forward cathedral-fort. The garrison is enormous and endlessly replenished.

forts.name: Sable Hold
forts.desc: A black-stone hold on the far marches. Farthest from home, biggest prize.
